overview.central_idea: The copyright page gives ordering information, the 2026 copyright of Manning Publications Co., legal notices on reproduction, trademarks, paper and liability, the production team, and the ISBN.

summary:
This is the **copyright page**. It contains:

- **Ordering information:** visit www.manning.com; bulk discounts via the Special Sales Department, Manning Publications Co., 20 Baldwin Road, PO Box 761, Shelter Island, NY 11964 (orders@manning.com).
- **Copyright:** © 2026 Manning Publications Co. All rights reserved.
- **Reproduction notice:** no part may be reproduced, stored or transmitted without the publisher's prior written permission.
- **Trademarks:** product names claimed as trademarks are printed in initial caps or all caps (e.g., names of frameworks and companies).
- **Paper policy:** acid-free paper (the ∞ symbol), at least 15 percent recycled, processed without elemental chlorine.
- **Disclaimer:** authors and publisher made every effort to ensure correctness at press time but disclaim liability for errors or omissions.
- **Production credits:** development editor Ian Hough, review editor Dunja Nikitović, production editor Kathy Rossland, copy editor Alisa Larson, proofreaders Katie Tennant and Melody Dolab, technical proofreader Gabriel Rasskin, typesetter Tamara Švelić Sabljić, cover designer Marija Tudor.
- **ISBN 9781633436589**, printed in the United States of America.

**How to use this page:** for citation (year 2026, ISBN). Note that, per the preface (p.18), the authors also make this edition available free online at https://deeplearningwithpython.io/ — the reproduction notice concerns copying the book, not reading that official online version.

questions.question: What is the copyright year and ISBN of this edition?

questions.question: What does the ∞ symbol next to the paper policy indicate?
options: The book is printed on acid-free paper
The book has an unlimited license
The book will be updated forever
questions.answer: The book is printed on acid-free paper
questions.explanation: The symbol introduces the statement that Manning prints on acid-free paper. It has nothing to do with licensing, edition count or online access.

questions.question: What should you do if a code example fails because a library has changed since publication?
questions.answer: Check the official code repository and errata (see p.22) — the disclaimer notes information was correct at press time only.
